chapter_seo_title: The Coldblade Sword Formation & the Social Life of a Sword Immortal – Desolate Era Ch. 233
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s treasure hunt ends with a devastating sword set. But his quiet planning is interrupted by an unexpected visit from two senior apprentice-sisters. A perfect blend of power progression and social drama.
og_description: Poor Ji Ning agonizes over Earth-ranked treasures before a surprise visit from Nine Lotos and a certain silver-robed ‘Qingqing’ heats things up.
twitter_title: Sword Formation Upgrade & Twin Qingqing Chaos
twitter_description: Ji Ning grabs a top-tier sword set while his social life gets interesting. Nine Lotos is a master of the well-timed joke.

lore_anchors.definition: The artifact spirit and gatekeeper of the War God Hall and Treasure Hall in the aquatic palace of Daoist Threelives (also known as the Three-Life Daoist). He is blunt, ancient, and operates on a strict, trial-based distribution system.

A set of nine top-grade Earth-ranked flying swords forged from the same source. They are individually more powerful than an ordinary Heaven-ranked treasure and are designed to be used in mass sword formations.
A top-grade Earth-ranked treasure that provides defensive and supplementary utility. It was one of the three options Ji Ning rejected in favor of immediate offensive power.
Another top-grade Earth-ranked treasure passed over by Ji Ning. ‘Cold Sha’ refers to a type of celestial, sentient cold energy. The mirror likely has powerful freezing or soul-targeting abilities.
The central marketplace of a commandery city, backed by the Grand Xia royal clan. It is the primary place where cultivators buy and sell high-grade treasures using Primordial Liquid as currency.

One of the premier immortal sects of the Anchan Commandery within the Grand Xia Dynasty. Ji Ning is a formal disciple of this college, which is known for its extremely selective admission and elite teachings.

Ji Ning’s senior apprentice-sister from the Black-White College. Her name literally means ‘Nine Lotuses.’ Her demeanor is elegant, composed, and she shares a warm, slightly teasing rapport with Ji Ning.

The ancient, primordial creator of the aquatic palace and its trials. Also known as the Starseizing Daoist, he is a legendary figure of immense power, and his inheritance is the source of Ji Ning’s greatest treasures.

The ultimate concentrated essence of all natural energy. In liquid form, it can be absorbed instantly by any cultivator without restriction, making it both a supreme cultivation resource and a high-value currency for immortal-level transactions.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning choose the Coldblade sword formation over the other treasures?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because it provides an immediate, massive power boost to his signature Lesser Thousand Sword Formation, while the other two treasures offered utility that wouldn't help him in his *next* fight.
He is the second most talented young cultivator in the entire Ji clan after Ji Ning. He has been out gaining combat experience and has now come to Serpentwing Lake seeking Ji Ning’s mentorship.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was the Skygreen Serpent, Qingqing, unable to sense Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he was inside the aquatic palace, which is a separate, ancient pocket dimension. This dimension is completely sealed off from the outside world, breaking the ordinary bond between a master and their spirit-beast.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is there a romantic plot between Ji Ning and Nine Lotos?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The text strongly hints at a growing closeness. Nine Lotos teasing Ji Ning about the ‘two Qingqings’ and her visiting him at his personal home are both clear signals of interest in a Xianxia social context.
